name: Rackmore's Silver Key
summary: Rackmore’s Silver Key is one of two keys needed to open a hidden chest on Ranazjar Isle. It is lost among the makrura of Desolace.

sections.title: The Lost Key
sections.body: Rackmore’s log tells how his ship was bound for Feathermoon Stronghold when seafaring creatures attacked. To keep his treasure from enemy hands, he hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle. The silver key was lost, and the chest remains locked until it is found with its golden counterpart.

faq.q: What does Rackmore’s Silver Key open?
faq.answer: Rackmore’s Silver Key is one of two keys needed to open Rackmore’s Chest on Ranazjar Isle. The golden key is the other.

faq.q: Where can I find Rackmore’s Silver Key?
faq.answer: Drysnap Pincers and Drysnap Crawlers in Desolace carry Rackmore’s Silver Key.
Rackmore was the owner of a treasure chest hidden on Ranazjar Isle after his ship was attacked.
Rackmore hid his chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep its treasure from falling into the hands of the creatures that attacked his ship.
Rackmore’s log says seafaring creatures attacked his ship while it was sailing for Feathermoon Stronghold.
